sentences.text: Abdul Rahaman vs Unknown on 17 January, 2024

Author: Debangsu Basak
Bench: Debangsu Basak

17.01.2024 Item No.5 CHC Allowed C.R.M.(A) 113 of 2024 In Re:- An application for anticipatory bail under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure in connection with Itahar Police Station Case No. 358 of 2023 dated 12.08.2023 under Sections 498A/323/307/376/511 of the Indian Penal Code.
And In the matter of : Abdul Rahaman ...... petitioner Ms. Busra Khatoon ....for the petitioner Mr.
Ashok Das ....for the State Petitioner prays for anticipatory bail.
Petitioner before us is the father-in-law of the de facto complainant.
Police complaint was filed 14 years after the marriage.
Husband of the de facto complainant was granted anticipatory bail.
In such circumstances, we grant anticipatory bail to the petitioner.

Accordingly, we direct that in the event of arrest the petitioner shall be released on bail upon furnishing a bond of Rs.10,000/- (Rupees Ten Thousand only), with two sureties of like amount each, to the satisfaction of the arresting officer and also be subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 and on further condition that the petitioner will report before the Investigating Officer once in a month till the conclusion of investigation and on condition that the petitioner shall appear on every date before the jurisdictional Court on and from the date fixed for appearance of the accused and in default the jurisdictional Court will pass appropriate order to secure the presence of the petitioner in Court including cancelling the anticipatory bail granted without further reference to this Court.
This application for anticipatory bail is, thus, allowed. CRM(A) 113 of 2024

(Debangsu Basak, J.) (Md. Shabbar Rashidi, J.)
